parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Choba-LawnTennisField (Lawn Tennis Field, University of Port Harcourt, Choba Town). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 91.2 | 2.535 | 2.535
2 | 380.2 | 15.83 | 18.37
3 | 43.25 | 20.36 | 38.73
4 | 474.3 | 33.05 | 71.78
5 | 597.1 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as A-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Choba-LawnTennisField (Lawn Tennis Field, University of Port Harcourt, Choba Town)
Curve type: A-type
Aquifer depth: 38.73 m – >71.78 m (layers 4 and 5; resistive sand/sandstone sequence underlying the low-resistivity clay aquitard at 18.37–38.73 m)
Recommendation: Drill through the clayey layer 3 (18.37–38.73 m) with proper casing/grouting to prevent cross-contamination, and target screening within the resistive layer 4/5 sequence from about 40 m to total depth (>72 m) for optimal water yield.
